name: Quest Global
h1: One connected view of every engineering programme
lede: As Quest Global folds BITSILICA into its semiconductor portfolio and takes on multi-year client frameworks, Airtable gives delivery, leadership and the board one shared picture of the work.
why_h2: Growth, governance and integration are all moving at once
why_p: Three recent moves raise the bar for how Quest Global coordinates programmes across clients, delivery centres and its newly strengthened board.

signals.title: BITSILICA acquisition strengthens semiconductors
signals.body: Quest Global acquired BITSILICA, an India-based semiconductor design services company, to build out its semiconductor portfolio.
signals.angle: Track integration workstreams, people, clients and milestones in one place instead of scattered trackers.

signals.title: Four independent directors join the board
signals.body: Quest Global appointed four independent directors to its Board, a significant step in its governance build-out.
signals.angle: Give leadership connected, live operational reporting rather than decks rebuilt for every board cycle.

signals.title: Five-year engineering framework with Babcock
signals.body: Quest Global entered a five-year Group Engineering Services Framework with Babcock, alongside an investment in Lavni Ventures Fund II.
signals.angle: Run framework call-offs, resourcing and delivery status for long-term clients from one shared system.
